text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What? Shave off time... bit by bit on 
every corner?

This was the strategy I entrusted to Tap 
Dance City. Namely—

"Devising better ways to take each corner 
to shave off 0.2 seconds per turn."

A middle-distance race has 4 corners, but 
a long-distance race has 6. 0.2 × 6 = we 
can gain "1.2 seconds."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see! Slowly, slowly building up, and 
before you know it—KABOOM!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Count me in on that plan!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wha-?! This race strategy is—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see, what she's targeting isn't the 
pace, but the course! Dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Look, Shakur! Behold my Golden Route! 
HAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!!!!!!!! We totally pulled it off!

Brilliantly pulling away from Air Shakur 
and the rest, Tap Dance City seized the 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, it pisses me off that a sure victory 
was snatched away, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Congrats, Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks, Shakur! Though I guess 
today's win was really thanks to the 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Like hell it is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Why's that?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Closing the gap on every corner. The 
logic behind it is..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I actually thought of something once too, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What, you knew? Then why did you...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do it. Even though I gave it a 
casual try.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't help being affected by the 
other Umamusume, and failed to hold my 
racing line..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining that for all six laps is 
something an ordinary Umamusume could 
never do."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"So quit being so humble. And tell that to 
your Trainer, too."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Good job, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Noâ

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait!" ...or something like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hear that, Trainer! Ahahaha!

It was a bit scary. But thanks to Air 
Shakur, it turned out to be a very 
meaningful match.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah, what I mean is... This victory is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your strategy plus my execution— that 
makes this a victory for both of us!

I believed Tap Dance City could do it. Her 
running relies on a solid foundation that 
won't yield to any rough seas.

"With this Kikuka Sho victory, Tap Dance 
City's strength was proven beyond a shadow 
of a doubt."
